title: The Day the Kettle Dreamed
skyStory: The moon swims into Pisces, still mostly hidden at four percent, and the whole sky goes a little dreamy and wet around the edges. Pisces is the sign of fish, fog and daydreams, and tonight it whispers soft nonsense to every kettle in Atlantic Canada. The kettles whistle back in harmony. Saturn pretends it cannot hear. It is humming along.

reading: Monday arrives in slippers. Your brain will feel like a snow globe someone just shook, all sparkle and no direction. Give it until 10 am to settle. Meanwhile, do the easiest task on your list and call it momentum.

In the afternoon, you will have a strange little daydream, something about a boat, or a bridge, or a cabin with a second chimney. Do not dismiss it. Pisces sends ideas in disguise. Sketch it on the back of an envelope. The [[Page of Cups]] is peeking around the corner, holding a fish, delighted that you noticed.
joel.mission: Doodle the strangest daydream you have today, however badly, and keep the drawing until the end of the week.
joel.omen: A kettle that whistles a moment early. It means an idea is ready before you think it is.
joel.stoneWhy: Pisces loves anything from the sea

reading: Fog rolls in off the shore of your imagination today. Things look softer. People seem kinder. Even the slush on the sidewalk has a certain poetic quality, if you squint and are wearing very good boots.

Someone will tell you a story that does not quite make sense, and the Wood Rat in you will spot the missing piece in about four seconds. Hand it back to them gently, like returning a dropped mitten. Your intuition is a lighthouse today. The Life Path 11 beam is on full, sweeping across the water.
nancy.mission: Notice the first piece of fog, steam or mist you see today and make a wish on it.
nancy.omen: A fish shape somewhere unexpected, on a sign or a mug. It means trust your gut on a decision this week.
nancy.stoneWhy: a lighthouse needs a clear lens

together.text: Describe your perfect foggy morning to each other in three sentences. Where are you, what are you holding, what can you hear. Pisces will collect both answers and blend them into one shared dream, delivered sometime this week while you sleep.

game.intro: The kettle dreamed last night and it's still a little steamy about it. Three fast picks, no overthinking.
